interpretation: Numerical results are not interval certificates.
At the exact simple zero F′/F is undefined. A symmetry-forced numerical real part of zero does not remove that pole.
Finite B_a is defined at the center when both shifted endpoint values are nonzero; reflection gives B_a=0 there.
Q(t)=|F′|²+Re(F″ F̄) on the critical line is the continuous transverse W/x coefficient. This report calls 2Q the first modal coefficient, consistent with the local quadratic convention.
Positive sampled Q and outward W around this zero do not establish global shear positivity or prevent every later collision.
Energy differences and tail probes are finite quadrature diagnostics; negative tau does not inherit a PSD guarantee from the UI.
